You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Kite Over the Rooftops",
  "slug": "kite-over-the-rooftops",
  "lang": "en",
  "gameType": "arcade-run",
  "loop": "Tap to lift the paper kite over rooftops, dodging chimneys and collecting ribbons as the wind speeds up. Hitting a chimney ends the flight and shows your ribbon tally.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `arcade-run`

# Arcade run

The world scrolls on its own, the player dodges and gathers, and one mistake ends the run.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `required`    |
| level                | `forbidden`   |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `lose`        |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above at least once: `score` as points change and `end` when the run is over. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden`. A run has no levels, so ramp difficulty with speed instead. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- The only allowed `end` reason is `lose`. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Fairness

A player who does nothing must survive for a few seconds after `start`. Spawn the first hazard well ahead of the player and keep the opening lane clear.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let last = 0,
  running = false,
  paused = false,
  score = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;
  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt);
    collide();
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function crash() {
  running = false;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}
```

Keep something moving on screen while idle (clouds, a pulsing prompt) so the run never looks frozen.

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll create the complete game page now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Kite Over the Rooftops</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  // ---- Sizing ----
  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
  function resize() {
    DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---- Palette ----
  const COL_BG = "#f4ecd8";
  const COL_LAYER = "#e07a5f";
  const COL_ACCENT = "#3d405b";
  const COL_HILITE = "#81b29a";

  // ---- Seeded jitter helper ----
  function makeRng(seed) {
    let s = seed >>> 0;
    return function () {
      s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
      return s / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  const rng = makeRng(20240521);
  function jitter(n) {
    return (rng() - 0.5) * n;
  }

  // Precompute a jittered polygon for reuse (seeded once, cached per shape id)
  const jitterCache = {};
  function jitteredPoints(id, pts, amt) {
    if (jitterCache[id]) return jitterCache[id];
    const out = pts.map(([x, y]) => [x + jitter(amt), y + jitter(amt)]);
    jitterCache[id] = out;
    return out;
  }

  function drawPaperPath(id, pts, amt, fillStyle, shadow) {
    const jp = jitteredPoints(id, pts, amt);
    ctx.save();
    if (shadow) {
      ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.shadowOffsetX = 1;
      ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(jp[0][0], jp[0][1]);
    for (let i = 1; i < jp.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(jp[i][0], jp[i][1]);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRectPath(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---- Game state ----
  let last = 0;
  let running = false;
  let paused = false;
  let started = false; // has boot been sent / has first frame drawn
  let score = 0;
  let ribbons = 0;
  let speed = 160; // px/sec base scroll speed
  let elapsed = 0;
  let bootSent = false;
  let firstTapDone = false;

  // Kite (player)
  const kite = {
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    vy: 0,
    r: 18,
  };

  function resetKite() {
    kite.x = W * 0.28;
    kite.y = H * 0.4;
    kite.vy = 0;
  }

  // Rooftop chimneys (hazards) and ribbons (collectibles)
  let chimneys = [];
  let ribbonsList = [];
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let ribbonSpawnTimer = 0;
  let rooftopY = 0;

  function backToTitle() {
    running = false;
    paused = false;
    started = false;
    score = 0;
    ribbons = 0;
    speed = 160;
    elapsed = 0;
    chimneys = [];
    ribbonsList = [];
    spawnTimer = 0;
    ribbonSpawnTimer = 0;
    resetKite();
  }

  function computeRooftop() {
    rooftopY = H * 0.82;
  }

  resetKite();
  computeRooftop();

  function spawnChimney(xOverride) {
    const w = 30 + rng() * 18;
    const h = 40 + rng() * 60;
    const x = xOverride !== undefined ? xOverride : W + 40;
    chimneys.push({ x, w, h, id: Math.floor(rng() * 1e9) });
  }

  function spawnRibbon() {
    const y = H * 0.15 + rng() * (H * 0.5);
    ribbonsList.push({ x: W + 30, y, id: Math.floor(rng() * 1e9), taken: false });
  }

  // Fairness: keep opening lane clear, spawn first hazard well ahead
  let openingGraceDistance = 0;

  function startPlay() {
    chimneys = [];
    ribbonsList = [];
    spawnTimer = 0;
    ribbonSpawnTimer = 0;
    score = 0;
    ribbons = 0;
    speed = 160;
    elapsed = 0;
    resetKite();
    // first hazard spawns well off to the right, giving a few seconds of clear flight
    spawnChimney(W + W * 0.9);
    CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
  }

  function crash() {
    if (!running) return;
    running = false;
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
  }

  // ---- Input ----
  canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (paused) return;
    if (!running) {
      running = true;
      firstTapDone = true;
      startPlay();
      CARTRIDGE.send("start");
      return;
    }
    act();
  });

  function act() {
    kite.vy = -260;
  }

  // ---- Host messages ----
  window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
    if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
    if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
    if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
  });

  // ---- Update ----
  function advance(dt) {
    elapsed += dt;
    speed += dt * 4; // ramp difficulty via speed

    // gravity + lift
    kite.vy += 420 * dt;
    kite.y += kite.vy * dt;

    const ceiling = H * 0.06;
    const floor = rooftopY - kite.r;
    if (kite.y < ceiling) {
      kite.y = ceiling;
      kite.vy = 0;
    }
    if (kite.y > floor) {
      kite.y = floor;
      kite.vy = 0;
      crash();
      return;
    }

    // spawn chimneys
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnChimney();
      spawnTimer = 1.4 + rng() * 0.9 - Math.min(elapsed * 0.01, 0.6);
      if (spawnTimer < 0.7) spawnTimer = 0.7;
    }

    // spawn ribbons
    ribbonSpawnTimer -= dt;
    if (ribbonSpawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnRibbon();
      ribbonSpawnTimer = 1.6 + rng() * 1.2;
    }

    // move chimneys
    for (const c of chimneys) {
      c.x -= speed * dt;
    }
    chimneys = chimneys.filter((c) => c.x + c.w > -20);

    // move ribbons
    for (const r of ribbonsList) {
      r.x -= speed * dt;
    }
    ribbonsList = ribbonsList.filter((r) => r.x > -20 && !r.taken);
  }

  function collide() {
    // chimney collision (rects rising from rooftop)
    for (const c of chimneys) {
      const top = rooftopY - c.h;
      const left = c.x;
      const right = c.x + c.w;
      if (
        kite.x + kite.r * 0.7 > left &&
        kite.x - kite.r * 0.7 < right &&
        kite.y + kite.r * 0.7 > top
      ) {
        crash();
        return;
      }
    }
    // ribbon collection
    for (const r of ribbonsList) {
      if (r.taken) continue;
      const dx = kite.x - r.x;
      const dy = kite.y - r.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < kite.r + 12) {
        r.taken = true;
        ribbons += 1;
        score += 10;
        CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- Drawing ----
  let cloudPhase = 0;

  function drawBackground(dt) {
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_BG;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // drifting clouds (keep motion visible while idle)
    cloudPhase += dt * 12;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const cx = ((i * 220 + cloudPhase) % (W + 200)) - 100;
      const cy = H * 0.15 + i * 40;
      drawCloud(`cloud${i}`, cx, cy, 40 + i * 6);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawCloud(id, x, y, r) {
    const pts = [
      [x - r, y],
      [x - r * 0.5, y - r * 0.6],
      [x, y - r * 0.7],
      [x + r * 0.5, y - r * 0.5],
      [x + r, y],
      [x + r * 0.6, y + r * 0.4],
      [x - r * 0.6, y + r * 0.4],
    ];
    drawPaperPath(id + "_" + Math.round(x / 50), pts, 3, "#ffffff", false);
  }

  function drawRooftops() {
    // rooftop base layer
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.3)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_LAYER;
    ctx.fillRect(0, rooftopY, W, H - rooftopY);
    ctx.restore();

    // roof ridge line (accent strip)
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.fillRect(0, rooftopY, W, 4);
  }

  function drawChimney(c) {
    const top = rooftopY - c.h;
    const id = "chim" + c.id;
    const pts = [
      [c.x, rooftopY],
      [c.x, top],
      [c.x + c.w, top],
      [c.x + c.w, rooftopY],
    ];
    drawPaperPath(id, pts, 2, COL_ACCENT, true);
    // little cap
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_LAYER;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x - 3, top - 6, c.w + 6, 8);
  }

  function drawRibbon(r) {
    if (r.taken) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(r.x, r.y);
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.25)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_HILITE;
    // simple ribbon shape: two triangles + circle knot
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-10, -4);
    ctx.lineTo(-2, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-10, 10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(10, -4);
    ctx.lineTo(2, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(10, 10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -2, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawKite() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(kite.x, kite.y);
    const angle = Math.max(-0.3, Math.min(0.5, kite.vy * 0.0006));
    ctx.rotate(angle);

    // tail
    ctx.strokeStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, kite.r * 0.8);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-6, kite.r * 1.6, 4, kite.r * 2.2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // kite diamond body (paper-cut style, jittered once per shape)
    const r = kite.r;
    const pts = [
      [0, -r * 1.3],
      [r, 0],
      [0, r * 1.3],
      [-r, 0],
    ];
    drawPaperPath("kitebody", pts, 2, COL_LAYER, true);

    // cross spar accent
    ctx.strokeStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -r * 1.3);
    ctx.lineTo(0, r * 1.3);
    ctx.moveTo(-r, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(r, 0);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawCard(text, x, y, w, h, fontSize) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.3)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_BG;
    roundRectPath(x, y, w, h, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.font = `700 ${fontSize}px -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(text, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 1);
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    const text = `Ribbons: ${ribbons}`;
    const w = Math.max(140, text.length * 12);
    drawCard(text, 12, 12, w, 40, 18);
  }

  function drawTitleScreen() {
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(elapsed * 3);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    const w = Math.min(320, W * 0.8);
    drawCard("Tap to begin", W / 2 - w / 2, H / 2 - 30, w, 60, 22);
    ctx.restore();

    const w2 = Math.min(360, W * 0.85);
    drawCard("Kite Over the Rooftops", W / 2 - w2 / 2, H * 0.28 - 30, w2, 60, 20);
  }

  function drawEndScreen() {
    const w = Math.min(340, W * 0.85);
    drawCard(`Flight over! Ribbons: ${ribbons}`, W / 2 - w / 2, H / 2 - 30, w, 60, 20);
    const w2 = Math.min(260, W * 0.7);
    drawCard("Tap to fly again", W / 2 - w2 / 2, H / 2 + 45, w2, 44, 16);
  }

  function draw(dt) {
    drawBackground(dt);
    drawRooftops();
    for (const c of chimneys) drawChimney(c);
    for (const r of ribbonsList) drawRibbon(r);
    drawKite();

    if (running) {
      drawHUD();
    } else if (!firstTapDone) {
      drawTitleScreen();
    } else {
      drawEndScreen();
    }

    if (paused) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      const w = Math.min(220, W * 0.6);
      drawCard("Paused", W / 2 - w / 2, H / 2 - 25, w, 50, 20);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  // reposition kite/rooftop after resize while idle/paused too
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    computeRooftop();
    if (!running) resetKite();
  });

  // ---- Main loop ----
  function frame(now) {
    if (!last) last = now;
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
    last = now;

    if (running && !paused) {
      advance(dt);
      if (running) collide();
    }

    draw(dt);

    if (!bootSent) {
      bootSent = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send("boot", {
        title: "Kite Over the Rooftops",
        gameType: "arcade-run",
        lang: "en",
      });
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
